top_signals.title: Badenoch vows to end £100k childcare cliff edge introduced under last Tory government
top_signals.summary: Tory leader Kemi Badenoch has vowed to end the “absurd” childcare trap for parents earning above £100,000. On the first day of the party’s conference in Birmingham, Badenoch will announce that the childcare cliff edge – engineered under the previous Tory government – will be scrapped at a cost of about £700m per year.  Former [...]

top_signals.title: Could White Hydrogen Succeed Where Green Hydrogen Stumbled?
top_signals.summary: The green hydrogen hype has all but stalled out – but could white hydrogen take its place as the next big thing in decarbonization? Geologic hydrogen, so-called ‘white’ hydrogen, could potentially bypass the most critical barriers to scaling hydrogen use without significantly expanding the sector’s carbon footprint.
